items.title: AIPAC Spends $1M+ Against Massie in 2024 Primary — Massie Wins 75%
items.summary: AIPAC's political arm, the United Democracy Project (UDP), spent over $1.1 million in negative advertising against Massie in the 2024 Republican primary in Kentucky's 4th district. Massie's opponent, Jimmy Ausbrooks (a first-time candidate with no prior political experience), received the bulk of his campaign support from AIPAC-aligned outside spending. Massie won the May 2024 primary with approximately 75% of the vote. The race became nationally prominent as an example of AIPAC's willingness to spend heavily to defeat members of Congress who vote against Israel aid bills — including Republicans. Massie has called AIPAC's involvement 'foreign influence' in American elections, noting that AIPAC advocates for the policy interests of a foreign government.

sources.name: Reuters
sources.description: Massie wins primary despite AIPAC spending

items.title: COVID Relief: Sole Dissenting Vote on $2.2T CARES Act
items.summary: In March 2020, Massie attempted to force a recorded roll-call vote on the $2.2 trillion CARES Act COVID relief bill, requiring members of Congress who were avoiding Washington due to COVID to return for an in-person quorum. President Trump called for Massie to be expelled from the Republican Party. Massie argued that passing a $2.2 trillion bill by voice vote with minimal debate was unconstitutional. The bill passed by voice vote when Massie's procedural motion failed to gain enough support.

sources.name: Reuters
sources.description: Massie attempts to force recorded vote on CARES Act
